situation: Moving our two-bed on Nov 8. Carla at Swift Movers quoted $1,650, Harbor Moving quoted $1,380 for the same job and addresses. I'd rather go with Swift (better reviews), want to ask them to come down.
reply: Hi Carla, I'd like to book Swift for our move on 8 November. One thing: Harbor quoted $1,380 for the same two-bed and the same addresses, and yours is $1,650. If you can do $1,400, I'll sign today and pay the deposit this afternoon. If not, I understand, and I'd still like to know what your price covers that theirs doesn't.
note: The quote is real and named; asking what's different gives them a way to hold price and still win you.

situation: Le quiero encargar 80 empanadas a doña Marta, una señora del barrio, para el cumple de mi papá el sábado 17. Me cobra 1.200 pesos cada una y yo las puedo pasar a buscar. ¿Cómo le pido un precio por cantidad sin quedar mal?
reply: Hola, doña Marta. Le quiero encargar 80 empanadas para el cumpleaños de mi papá, el sábado 17. Como es un pedido grande y las paso a buscar yo, ¿me las dejaría a 1.050 cada una? Si le parece bien, le transfiero la seña hoy mismo. Y si no se puede, no pasa nada, se las encargo igual.
note: With a neighbour you'll see again, the out is generous on purpose: the relationship is worth more than the 12,000 pesos.

situation: 宽带合约下个月到期，续约报价一年1,680元，但官网新用户同样的300兆套餐只要1,200。我用了五年了，想打客服电话要个优惠。
reply: 你好，我是用了五年的老用户，宽带下个月到期，我打算继续用。现在给我的续约价是一年1,680元，官网上新用户同样的300兆套餐是1,200元。老用户能按1,200元续吗？可以的话我现在就在电话里办好。如果办不了也理解，麻烦帮我转一下能处理续约优惠的同事。
note: 如果对方说价格定死了，退一步要附加项：送三个月或者免费提速。

situation: Our wedding photographer, Lena, quoted $3,900 for 8 hours. I asked if she could do $3,500 and she said her price is firm. She normally offers an engagement shoot as a $350 add-on. We still want her. Wedding is May 22, 2027.
reply: Understood, thanks for being straight with me. We'd still love to have you. If the price is firm, could you include the engagement shoot you normally offer as a $350 add-on? Either way we're ready to book, so send over the contract and I'll pay the deposit this week.
note: After a clear no on price, one perk ask, and say you'll book either way so it costs her nothing to refuse.

situation: My lease renews Nov 30 and the landlord's agent, Tessa, wants to raise rent from $2,150 to $2,350. I've paid on time for three years, and unit 4B in my building is listed at $2,250. I want to stay.
reply: Hi Tessa, thanks for sending the renewal. I'd like to stay another year. Given three years of on-time rent and that 4B is listed at $2,250, could we do $2,200 on a 12-month lease? If that works I'll sign this week. If not, I understand, just let me know where you can land.
note: Two real anchors (track record and a live listing), a specific number below the comparable, and a quick signature as the reason to say yes.

situation: Ich will mich im Fitnessstudio FitWerk bei mir um die Ecke anmelden, 24-Monats-Vertrag für 34,90 € im Monat. Dazu kommt eine Anmeldegebühr von 49 €. Mein Kollege hat im August ohne Gebühr unterschrieben, weil da eine Aktion lief.
reply: Hallo, ich möchte heute den 24-Monats-Vertrag für 34,90 € abschließen. Im August hatten Sie eine Aktion ohne Anmeldegebühr, darüber hat mein Kollege unterschrieben. Könnten Sie mir die 49 € auch erlassen? Dann unterschreibe ich gleich jetzt. Wenn das nicht geht, ist es auch in Ordnung.
note: Ein echter Anker plus sofortige Unterschrift. Bei einem Nein nach einem Extra fragen, etwa einem Gratismonat, statt nachzuverhandeln.

situation: 想在4S店买一台白色混动轿车，销售王经理报的落地价是14.8万。我打算全款，明天9月30号（月底）就能去签，想谈到14.2万左右。
reply: 王经理您好，那台白色混动轿车我已经决定买了，全款，不走贷款。您报的落地价是14.8万，如果能做到14.0万，我明天9月30号上午就过去签合同、当场付款，正好赶在月底前。实在做不到也理解，您给我回一个能做到的价就行。
note: 没有竞品报价就别编，用全款和月底成交做筹码；如果价格不动，再退一步只要一个附加项，比如贴膜或首保。

situation: I'm self-employed with a high-deductible plan, and I got a $2,480 bill from Lakeview General for an ER visit on 14 August. I can pay in full now but it hurts. Want to ask their billing office for a discount.
reply: Hi, I'm calling about my ER visit on 14 August, with a balance of $2,480. I'd like to pay it in full today by card. Do you offer a prompt-pay discount for settling the whole balance at once? I was hoping for around 30 percent, so $1,736. If that's not something you do, could you tell me what discount you can offer, or whether you have a financial assistance program I might qualify for?
note: Paying in full today is a lever many billing offices respond to; ask for a number, then a named fallback if they can't meet it.

situation: I'm Maya Collins, operations at Eastside Food Pantry in Dayton, a registered 501(c)(3). We want to move volunteer scheduling to Rosterly, whose Team plan is $1,440 a year for 10 seats. Their site doesn't mention nonprofit pricing, but we're ready to switch this month.
reply: Hi, we're a registered 501(c)(3) food bank in Dayton and we'd like to move our volunteer scheduling to Rosterly this month. The Team plan for 10 seats is $1,440 a year. Do you offer nonprofit pricing? We're hoping for around half off, so $720, and we'd pay the full year upfront the day it's approved. If there's no nonprofit rate, I understand; could you tell me whether annual prepay changes the price? Thanks, Maya Collins, Operations, Eastside Food Pantry
note: Nonprofit status is a real anchor. Name the number, offer upfront payment as the easy yes, and have one fallback question ready.

situation: 给公司团建订莫干山一家民宿包栋，10月20日、21日（周二、周三）两晚，22个人。老板张先生报价每晚8,800元。国庆后的工作日应该是淡季，我想谈到每晚7,500元左右，没有别家报价。
reply: 张老板您好，我们公司定了10月20日、21日（周二、周三）两晚团建，22个人，很想就定在您家包栋。报价是每晚8,800元，因为是国庆后的工作日，想问能不能按每晚7,500元，两晚一共15,000元？可以的话，我今天就把定金转给您。如果价格不好动，也没关系，跟我说一声就行。
note: 没有竞品报价就不编，用淡季工作日和当天付定金做筹码；价格不动就只再要一个附加项，比如含早餐或延迟退房。

situation: I want the Hayes 3-seater sofa at a furniture store, listed at $1,899. The floor model has a scuff on the back left leg and a pulled thread on one cushion. I'd happily take the floor model today if they knock something off.
reply: Hi, I'd like to buy the Hayes sofa today and I'm happy to take the floor model as it is. It has a scuff on the back left leg and a pulled thread on one cushion, so would you do $1,550 for it? If yes, I'll pay now and book delivery for this Saturday.
note: The wear is the anchoring fact, stated plainly without running the sofa down. If the price is firm, ask for free delivery before paying.

situation: 想给两个孩子（7岁和9岁）在小区附近的琴行报钢琴课，一对一每节200元，一学期16节。我打算两个孩子一起报、一次性交清，想问问王老师能不能便宜点。
reply: 王老师您好，这学期想给两个孩子一起报名，每人16节，原价一共6,400元，我可以开课前一次性交清。两人同报的话，能不能按每节180元算，也就是5,760元？可以的话我这周六就来签。如果不方便也完全理解，我们就按原价上。
note: 没有别家报价时，用“两人同报加一次付清”做筹码，报一个具体数字，并给老师留面子的退路。

situation: J'ai acheté le manteau en laine Alma chez Maison Verne le 23 septembre, 240 € (commande 50412). Il est maintenant affiché à 180 € sur leur site. Je ne sais pas s'ils font des ajustements de prix, je voudrais leur écrire.
reply: Bonjour, j'ai acheté le manteau Alma en laine le 23 septembre pour 240 € (commande 50412), et je l'adore. Je vois qu'il est aujourd'hui affiché à 180 € sur votre site. Pourriez-vous me rembourser la différence de 60 € sur ma carte ? Si ce n'est pas possible, un avoir du même montant me conviendrait très bien. Et si vous ne pratiquez pas d'ajustement de prix, je comprends tout à fait. Merci d'avance.
note: Après l'achat, le fait d'ancrage est leur propre prix affiché : demander la différence, proposer l'avoir en repli, sans menacer de retourner l'article.

situation: Luis from Northside Painting estimated $3,150 on site to paint our three bedrooms and hallway in October, but his written quote is $3,400, including a $250 'materials handling' fee he never mentioned. We want to book him.
reply: Hi Luis, thanks for the written quote, we'd like to go ahead with you for the three bedrooms and the hallway in October. One thing: the quote includes a $250 materials handling fee that didn't come up when you estimated $3,150 on site. Could you drop that fee and do it for $3,150? If yes, I'll sign and pay the deposit this week. If the fee needs to stay, no problem, just let me know what it covers.
note: An unexpected fee is a clean anchor: name it, ask for the number you were first given, and ask what it covers rather than accusing.

situation: Meu dentista, o Dr. Paulo, orçou um clareamento mais duas restaurações em R$ 3.200, parcelado em 4x no cartão. Consigo pagar tudo à vista por transferência. Quero pedir um desconto pra secretária, a Juliana, pelo WhatsApp.
reply: Oi, Juliana, tudo bem? Quero fechar o tratamento com o Dr. Paulo, o clareamento e as duas restaurações, orçado em R$ 3.200. Se eu pagar tudo à vista por transferência, vocês fariam por R$ 2.800? Se der certo, já faço a transferência hoje e marco a primeira sessão. Se não tiver como, sem problema, me diz qual é o valor à vista de vocês.
note: Sem orçamento concorrente, a alavanca é pagar tudo à vista: peça um número e deixe espaço para o desconto padrão deles.

situation: Our home internet with Clearwave was down for five days, Sept 21 to 25, and I work from home. The plan is $80 a month and I've been with them four years. I want to ask for a credit on the next bill.
reply: Hi, I'm calling about our home internet. Our service was down from 21 to 25 September, five full days, and I work from home, so it hit hard. I've been with you four years and I'm happy to stay. Could you credit half of this month's bill, $40, on the next statement? If that's more than you can do, I'd appreciate at least the prorated amount for the five days.
note: The outage is the anchor: ask for a specific credit a little above prorated, and name the fallback so a smaller yes is still easy.

situation: 公司附近新开了一家瑜伽馆，年卡每人3,600元。我在部门里问了一圈，有8个同事想一起办。想跟馆长林老师谈个团购价，目标每人3,000元左右，8张卡这周内一起付清。
reply: 林老师您好，我们公司就在附近，部门里有8个同事都想在您这里办年卡。年卡原价每人3,600元，8个人一起办的话，能不能按每人3,000元，一共24,000元？可以的话，这周内8张卡一起付清。如果这个价格做不到也理解，您看团体办卡最多能给到多少，我再去跟同事们商量。
note: 团购的筹码是人数和一次付清；报一个具体数字，再给对方一个说出自己价格的台阶。

situation: 箱根の旅館を11月21日（土）に1泊2食で予約しています。今回で3回目の宿泊で、ちょうど結婚10周年の旅行です。もし空いていれば、露天風呂付きの客室にアップグレードしてもらえないか、前日に電話で聞いてみたいです。私は佐藤です。
reply: お世話になっております。明日11月21日に1泊2食で予約している佐藤です。今回で3回目の宿泊になり、ちょうど結婚10周年の旅行です。もし露天風呂付きの客室に空きがあれば、アップグレードしていただくことは可能でしょうか。難しければもちろん今のお部屋で十分です。明日を楽しみにしております。
note: 値引きではなく特典のお願い：本当の事実（リピーター、記念日）を一つ添え、具体的な部屋を挙げ、断りやすい一言で締める。

situation: A seller called Sam has a used blue hybrid bike listed on a local marketplace for $450. Two similar bikes nearby are listed at $380 and $400. I can collect tomorrow evening and pay cash.
reply: Hi Sam, I'm keen on the blue hybrid and could collect it tomorrow evening with cash. There are a couple of similar ones listed nearby at $380 and $400, so would you take $390? If that's too low, no problem, just let me know your best price.
note: With a private seller, cash and a quick pickup are the lever; point to real listings and never run the bike down.

situation: I want to sign up for an online bookkeeping course from Ledgerwise. The early-bird price was $299 until last night at midnight; it's now $399. I was on their webinar last week and meant to pay, but missed it by a few hours.
reply: Hi, I'd like to enrol in the bookkeeping course today. I was on last week's webinar and meant to book at the early-bird price of $299, but missed the midnight deadline by a few hours. Could you still honour $299 for me? If yes, I'll pay as soon as you send the link. If not, I understand, and I'll go ahead at $399.
note: The anchor is a real, recent price you just missed; say you'll buy either way, so it costs them nothing to say yes.

situation: We've taken both our cars to Dave's garage for eight years. He's quoted $1,240 for a timing belt and water pump on my car. I don't have another quote, but I'd like to ask for $1,100 as a long-time customer, and I can drop the car off whichever day next week suits him.
reply: Hi Dave, thanks for the quote, I'd like to go ahead with the timing belt and water pump. We've brought both cars to you for eight years, so I wondered whether you could do it for $1,100. I can drop it off whichever day next week suits you best. If the price is set, no problem, just book me in at $1,240.
note: No rival quote, so the levers are loyalty and flexible timing; saying you'll book either way makes the ask cost him nothing.

situation: 婚礼跟拍摄像李师傅报价6,800元，我问能不能5,500，他说最低6,200。我们很想定他，想试试6,000成交，定金今天就能付；如果6,200真是底价，也可以接受。
reply: 李师傅，谢谢您愿意让到6,200。我们真的很想定您，6,000整可以吗？可以的话我今天就把定金转过去。如果6,200就是底价，也没关系，我们就按6,200定。
note: 对方已经还了价，再往前走一小步就好，并说清楚不行也照样成交，给对方留面子。

situation: I'm ordering 500 flyers for my yoga studio's open day from a local print shop, quoted at $210. I asked the owner, Ken, for 15% off and he said he can only do 10% off if I order 1,000. I only need 500, and I can pay upfront today.
reply: Thanks, Ken, that's a fair offer, but 1,000 flyers would just sit in a cupboard. For the 500, could you do $190 if I pay upfront today? If $210 is the price, no problem, I'll go ahead at that.
note: Turning down a volume upsell: say plainly why it doesn't fit, make one smaller counter, and show you'll buy either way.

situation: 我们在一家酒店订了18桌婚宴，每桌3,688元，定金已付。酒店规定自带酒水每桌收200元开瓶服务费，我们打算自己带白酒和红酒，一共3,600元。另外还准备在这家酒店给外地亲戚订6间房。想请宴会部的赵经理免掉这笔服务费。
reply: 赵经理您好，我们在您这里订了18桌婚宴，酒水打算自己带。按规定每桌收200元开瓶服务费，一共3,600元。另外我们还准备在酒店给外地亲戚订6间房，想问这笔服务费能不能免掉？可以的话，房间我这周就跟您这边订好。如果全免不好办，减半也很感谢；实在不行也理解，我们照规定来。
note: 已经是大客户，筹码是追加的客房；先要全免，再给一个减半的台阶，最后说明不行也照常合作。
